_comment: Tier-0 crafted intermediate. Bark scrap trimmed and split -- the wood beneath the outer black. Used as the shaft for the fire weapon tree (torch base) and eventually other tool crafts. Universal, class-agnostic; both Wood-side and Hell-side crafters use the same stick.
name: Stick
description: A length of pale pine, split from the inner bark. Straight enough to hold, hard enough to burn.
